jobs.title: (Senior) Software Engineer - Data Integration Focus - Remote (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At praxipal, we are building an AI-powered healthcare admin workforce to address the global shortage of medical staff.

Medical assistants are too valuable to spend their days chasing callbacks, cleaning up schedules, sending repetitive messages, or wrestling with invoicing and documentation workflows. Staff should spend time on patients. That’s why we build Luna.

Our AI receptionist, Luna, answers and automates phone calls and she’s loved by hundreds of medical practitioners. Right now, we’re expanding her from calls to end-to-end patient communication across any channel. Over the next years, we’ll grow her into an AI worker that automates all administrative processes in medical practices, embedded directly into the systems practice teams already use.

We’re backed by one of Europe’s leading investors and are one of the fastest growing healthtech startups in Germany. Our team has previously worked and studied at Palantir, Amazon, SAP, the University of Cambridge, and Hasso Plattner Institute.

We're hiring a (Senior) Software Engineer to help us scale Luna from hundreds of medical practitioners to hundreds of thousands.

 

The role

Integration is the bottleneck and the unlock: Luna can only automate workflows when she can reliably read and write the source of truth inside a practice: schedules, patient context, messages, statuses, and workflow metadata. That data lives in practice management systems (PMS) and related tools.

You’ll work hands-on, shipping production integrations. As the integration surface grows, you’ll shape the architecture, standards, and processes that keep integration work scalable.

 
 

What you'll do

Build integrations that unlock Luna’s next capabilities

  • Design and implement read/write integrations into third-party practice management systems

  • Design infrastructure that scales to hundreds of thousands of individual practice servers

  • Engineer reliability into the system: data consistency, idempotency, retries, error handling, observability

  • Triage integration failures in production, communicate impact clearly, and harden the system so the same class of failure doesn’t repeat

Make integration a scalable capability

  • Define technical standards and architecture for integrations

  • Establish pragmatic processes for development, maintenance, and incident handling

 

What we're looking for

Must-have

  • Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, TypeScript and/or Rust

  • Proven experience building and running software in production

  • Strong understanding of integration patterns, distributed systems, and failure modes

  • Comfort operating in messy environments (inconsistent behavior, missing docs, etc.)

  • Clear communication under pressure (during incidents, vendor issues, competing priorities)

  • Excited to work in a fast-paced environment

Nice-to-have

  • Prior work on healthcare software or practice management systems

  • Familiarity with healthcare workflows, terminology, or data standards (e.g. FHIR)

  • Fluent German (spoken and written)

  • Experience in startups or scale-ups

 

Location & compensation

  • Location: Remote

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and participation in our VSOP program

  • Team bonding: Regular get-togethers, happy hours and offsites

  • Health and productivity: Urban Sports Club subscription

 

If you want to shape the next generation of healthcare software with us, apply now.

Compensation: €70K – €100K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: UX/UI Designer | Intch
jobs.description:
About Intch

Intch is a professional social network with a marketplace for part time work. You can think of it as a professional network built for senior specialists who take on meaningful contracts alongside their main work. A typical contract lasts from three to six months.

The product is used in 140 countries and is available in up to 20 languages. Intch has fewer than 40 people and four product areas, with three already live and one preparing to launch.

Intch is rethinking how people and companies find each other and build trust online. Changes that made the interface feel more like a real conversation have already improved key metrics by up to three times.

About the role

Today one part time designer supports all Intch products. Since the company moved to a product based structure, that is no longer enough. Intch is now looking for its first full time designer.

Product managers build and test early prototypes themselves. Around one in ten experiments moves forward. Your role is to join the thinking early, work through the problem with the product team and turn validated ideas into clear, production ready experiences.

This is a hands on role with broad ownership. You will work across all Intch products and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers and the current designer.

What you will work on

  • Join product discussions early and help shape the problem before screens are made.

  • Take a task from an open question to a production ready design.

  • Design flows where the interface supports communication between people and businesses.

  • Work on onboarding, profiles, discovery, paywalls and other core product areas.

  • Cover key states, edge cases and handoff details, then stay involved during implementation.

  • Extend the existing UI kit and keep patterns consistent across products.

  • Increase the share of design work that can move into production without another rework round.

What matters for this role

  • Strong UI craft and a portfolio of clear, thoughtful interfaces.

  • Solid web product experience. Web is the primary platform at Intch.

  • The ability to explain your decisions through user context, not personal taste.

  • Openness to evidence and the confidence to change your mind when a better argument appears.

  • Experience owning design from an unclear problem through to launch.

  • Comfort working with autonomy in a small product company.

  • Experience in a startup, as a founding designer or in an in-house product role, would be useful.

  • A practical approach to AI tools. The current workflow includes Figma handoff and clickable prototypes in Claude. Production code is not expected.

  • English at B1, fluent Russian.

What you get

  • Remote, open geography. Time zone overlap with ~CET is what matters.

  • Flexible schedule. Paid vacation, sick leave, and days off.

  • A flat team under 40 where you can bring a worked-out idea into any product — and get paid for it if it performs.

  • A design problem the market hasn't solved yet, in a product used across 140 countries.

  • Real autonomy from day one. You'll sit in product discussions, not receive tickets.

As a Senior Pipeline Technical Director for Film 2D, you'll play a central role in building a resilient, intelligent VFX pipeline that removes technical friction and keeps our artists focused on creative delivery. You'll focus on supporting and enhancing production workflows across our 2D division, covering Compositing, Paint & Roto, Editorial, and Review Tools.

From building robust Python tools to pioneering practical machine learning integrations (such as Switchlight, SAM3, and ComfyUI workflows), you'll help automate complex tasks and streamline shot delivery. jobs.description:
Unser Mandant entwickelt innovative Decision-Intelligence-Software für datengestützte Entscheidungen und komplexe betriebliche Abläufe. Das Ziel ist es, Organisationen dabei zu helfen, Abhängigkeiten transparent zu machen, Handlungsoptionen zu evaluieren und Entscheidungen zu treffen, deren Logik und Annahmen jederzeit nachvollziehbar sind. Dafür wird eine leistungsfähige Kerntechnologie aufgebaut, die strukturiertes Wissen, logisches Schlussfolgern (Reasoning), Planung und KI-Komponenten vereint.

Als Senior Backend Engineer konzipierst und baust du zentrale Kernkomponenten dieser Software. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem CTO und dem Engineering-Team übersetzt du technische Konzepte und Algorithmen in hochverlässliche Software, gestaltest Schnittstellen sowie Datenstrukturen und übernimmst die Verantwortung für Komponenten vom Entwurf bis hin zur Integration und Validierung.

  • Kernentwicklung: Konzeption und Implementierung von Backend-Komponenten zur Abbildung von Abhängigkeiten, Evaluierung von Szenarien und Unterstützung von Reasoning- sowie Planungs-Workflows.

  • Architektur & APIs: Aufbau klarer APIs, Datenstrukturen und Schnittstellen für das nahtlose Zusammenspiel der Engine-Komponenten und zukünftige Erweiterungen.

  • Prototyp-Transformation: Überführung von Prototypen und algorithmischen Konzepten in wartbare, skalierbare Software (inkl. Fundierter Entscheidungen bezüglich Eigenentwicklung vs. Integration bestehender Tools).

  • Qualität & Performance: Verantwortung für die Komponentenqualität durch automatisierte Tests, Benchmarks, Debugging und Profiling zur Sicherstellung von Korrektheit und Performance.

  • Nachvollziehbarkeit & Diagnostik: Entwicklung von Diagnosewerkzeugen und Strukturen, um Ergebnisse in Bezug auf Eingaben, Modellversionen und Annahmen jederzeit rückverfolgbar zu machen.

  • Produkt-Zusammenarbeit: Übersetzung von Kundenanwendungsfällen gemeinsam mit dem Produktteam in technische Akzeptanzkriterien und wiederverwendbare Kernverbesserungen.

  • Engineering Standards: Aktive Mitgestaltung von Code-Reviews, Dokumentationen sowie Build- und Deployment-Workflows für eine saubere Codebasis.


  • Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Mathematik, Software Engineering, Physik oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation.

  • Backend-Expertise: Starke Programmierkenntnisse in mindestens einer Backend-Sprache (z. B. Python, Java, C++, Go oder Rust) sowie Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit bestehenden Codebasen.

  • Fundament: Solides Wissen in Algorithmen, Datenstrukturen, Softwaredesign und automatisiertem Testen.

  • Schnittstellen & Daten: Erfahrung im API-Design sowie in der Arbeit mit Datenspeicher- und Datenverarbeitungssystemen unter Berücksichtigung von Performance- und Verlässlichkeitsparametern.

  • Mindset: Fähigkeit, komplexe und unklare Problemstellungen eigenständig zu zerlegen, Alternativen zu bewerten und verlässliche Software-Inkremente zu liefern.

  • Kommunikation & Arbeitsweise: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie Freude an schnellen, iterativen Entwicklungsschritten im Team.

Von Vorteil (kein MUSS):

Erfahrungen in mindestens einem der folgenden Bereiche sind ein Pluspunkt:

  • Graphbasierte Systeme oder Wissensrepräsentation

  • Planung, Terminierung (Scheduling) oder Optimierung

  • Rule Engines oder Constraint Solver

  • Integration von ML- / LLM-Komponenten

  • Überführung von Forschungsprototypen in den Produktionsbetrieb

Warum wir?

  • Technologischer Impact: Gestalte die Kerntechnologie in einer frühen Phase entscheidend mit.

jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Heartbeat AI is our energy optimisation platform that always provides our customers with the cleanest and cheapest energy. As the (Senior) Go-to-Market Scaling Manager - Germany, your first focus is optimising the performance, positioning, and monetisation of Heartbeat AI within our largest and most established market while adding new products to it and making sure our new customer-facing features get seen. You will take ownership of what's already working and what isn't, fine-tuning pricing, packaging, and go-to-market execution while working closely across Product, Tech, Sales, and Marketing to keep the German market performing at its full potential.

  • You own the performance and monetisation of Heartbeat AI within the German market, working to continuously optimise what's already in place rather than build from zero.
  • You fine-tune pricing and packaging, identify where existing structures are leaving value on the table, and drive the changes needed to capture it.
  • You bring new positioning ideas to an already mature market, testing and validating fresh angles alongside the initiatives already running.
  • You develop a deep understanding of the unit economics behind Heartbeat AI in Germany, using that insight to shape monetisation strategy across pricing, packaging, and the broader product suite.
  • You work closely with Product, Tech, Marketing, and Sales stakeholders, translating technical constraints into commercial decisions and commercial priorities into technical requirements.
  • You track performance across the German market, using data to spot where monetisation or positioning is underperforming and turning that into concrete action.
  • You operate with significant cross-functional influence, managing diagonally across tech, sales, and marketing to keep initiatives moving.
  • You report into the Go-to-Market Director, working closely with senior leadership to present performance updates and build the case for changes to positioning or monetisation strategy.

Dein Profil

  • You are confident optimising an already-established market, spotting where fine-tuning pricing, packaging, or positioning can unlock further performance.

  • You are confident presenting to and working directly with executives and can turn data and KPIs into clear, decision-ready updates.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Fully Remote (Global)

Classification: Full-time; 40 hours per week

Pay Range: €51,000-90,000

Experience: 2+ years as a QA engineer

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! Our K-8 platforms include Miacademy, Always Icecream, and Clever Dragons, and our 9-12 options include MiaPrep and MiaPrep Online High School. Our student base is rapidly growing, and we’re hiring for multiple positions across several departments! Our expansion stems from our commitment to providing exceptional educational content and our pursuit of new opportunities. 🚀

▶️ You can hear our CEO, Johannes Ziegler, discuss our company’s values and future!

How you’ll make an impact (position summary):

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

The Role

We're looking for a QA Engineer to join our current QA team. You'll take ownership of how we test, validate, and sign off on quality across our platform. We're actively investing in our QA practice: expanding automated test coverage, improving our release testing process, and moving toward a model where quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle.

You'll report to a technical Engineering Manager and work alongside engineers who value clear test documentation, reliable automation, and confident code releases.

As a mature company, we have legacy systems and established manual testing workflows, but we are transitioning to modern automated testing practices using Playwright and TypeScript. The split between manual and automated work varies, but you should be comfortable working across both, bringing automation where it adds the most value while pragmatically maintaining manual coverage where it's still the right tool.

A core goal of our QA evolution is to make testing faster, more reliable, and less dependent on last-minute changes before each release: replacing fragile manual regression cycles with stable automated suites, reducing flakiness, and building coverage that the whole team can rely on. Every testing investment is measured by whether it improves quality and reduces the team's burden at release time.

What You'll Do

  • Write and maintain automated regression tests; review automation MRs from peers

  • Execute manual testing across web UIs (functional, regression, cross-platform, responsive layouts on mobile/tablet)

  • Create and maintain test cases, checklists, and test documentation in TestRail

  • File clear, actionable bug reports with reproduction steps; collaborate with developers to triage and resolve

  • Own the release testing process to ensure only high-quality changes ship

  • Partner with PMs and designers on requirements review, edge cases, and acceptance criteria

  • Contribute to QA process improvements as we scale (currently a 2-person team growing to 4)

How We Work

We believe you should know what your days look like before you accept an offer.

We don't have much bureaucracy. Small team, direct communication, short decision loops. If you've worked at places where opening a Jira ticket to request a Jira ticket was normal, this isn't that. Here's the reality:

Meetings (yes, we keep them minimal):

  • Daily standup with your product team. Show up, share updates and unblock each other..

  • Sprint planning and retrospectives with your product team, once per sprint.

  • 1:1 with your Engineering Manager - Regular cadence, your agenda.

  • Monthly Engineering all-hands.

  • That's it. The rest of your time is yours to work.

Deployments:

  • Bi-monthly release cadence with a schedule published in advance. As a QA Engineer, you own the release testing window. Coordinating with developers, running regression suites, and signing off on quality before the release.

  • Infrequent ad-hoc hotfixes

Communication:

  • Async-friendly. Documentation-first.

  • Slack/ Jira/ GitLab MRs/ Notion

  • Google Workspace for email and documents.

  • Zoom for video calls.

Timezone:

  • We need significant overlap with typical CET (Central European Time) working hours to coordinate and collaborate synchronously. Additionally we have stakeholders and developers in US timezones that we occasionally need to meet.


What We're Looking For

Requirements (Requisite Skills): 

  • 2+ years of QA engineering experience, including web UI testing

  • 2+ years of experience with Playwright or a similar test automation framework (e.g. Cypress, Selenium, Puppeteer)

  • 2+ years of experience using TypeScript

  • Strong test design skills: comfortable writing and maintaining test cases, checklists, and test documentation

  • Familiarity with QA's role in the SDLC and how to collaborate with developers and PMs

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

  • Upper-intermediate English (B2+) for written and spoken communication

  • Strong experience in manual testing and writing manual test cases

Nice to have:

  • Experience with accessibility and/or security testing

How you’ll work with other teams:

Career Growth

We have a defined career ladder. Whether your path leads toward Senior/Staff QA Engineer or Engineering Management, there's room to grow - and we'll work with you to get there.

Onboarding

Every team member gets full support throughout onboarding, and no one expects you to figure out the ins and outs on your own. We'll pair with you, answer every question, and make sure you have the context you need. New hires typically feel very supported at Miaplaza.

What success looks like here: In the first couple of months, you're asking a lot of clarifying questions, reading documentation, exploring the product independently, and writing and running tests with confidence. By months 3-4, you're taking ownership of a specific area, building out test coverage, identifying gaps, and driving quality improvements. By month 5-6, you're contributing meaningfully to the testing strategy for migration and modernisation work and operating independently. The common thread: curiosity, initiative, and the habit of investigating before you ask, but always asking when you need to.

Interview Process

Our process is staged and designed to respect your time. Expect a mix of introductory conversation, technical discussion, and practical evaluation. We want to understand how you think about real problems and testing practices. As part of the process, we will ask for professional references and conduct a background check in accordance with applicable law. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, let us know, we're happy to help.

Compensation

Competitive compensation, open to negotiation based on your experience and expertise. We'll discuss specifics early in the process so neither side wastes time. Since we’re remote-first, every arrangement is different; we tailor time off, benefits, and perks as part of your individual contract to ensure the overall package works for both sides.

Ready to apply?

Join our team at Miaplaza! Start by submitting your application and resume. Our hiring process involves a screening call, followed by a behavioral interview, and two technical interviews.

jobs.title: Customer Support Agent (Norwegian speaking)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a skilled and customer-oriented individual to join our team as a Customer Support Adviser. As a key member of our customer service department, you will play a vital role in providing exceptional support and assistance to our valued customers. The ideal candidate will possess strong communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and a passion for delivering top-notch customer experiences.

Tasks

  • Handling Customer enquiries through the various platforms available (Chat, Email and phone) through both inbound and outbound channels.
  • Using logical questioning skills in an appropriate manner to obtain the maximum relevant information from the customer in the minimum effective time
  • Using well-developed negotiation skills to provide resolutions to problems and offer suitable courses of action to prevent escalation
  • Maximise any revenue-generating opportunities identified
  • Accurate data input
  • Manage your own time in line with resource planners
  • Dealing directly with colleagues around the business to obtain missing information
  • Meet the pre-determined team and operational sales and service Key Performance Indicators and behaviours in job role
  • Manage the escalation process for customer resolution with empathy
  • Working with multiple back offices, internal tools as well as engaging 3rd parties (Games providers) to ensure customer queries are answered and/or resolved in a timely and correct manner
  • Assisting customers encountering issues with processing payments (Credit Cards, Bank transfers, E-wallets, Crypto and Paysafe)
  • Assisting customers with their KYC procedure - Also working closely with the Risk team in this matter
  • Working closely with the VIP, Marketing and Risk/Payments department
  • Crediting bonuses & Free spins
  • Actively engaging customers in the view to increase player activity
  • Providing the necessary support for the creation, implementation and continuity of the processes required for the Information Security Management System. Fulfilling all the duties assigned by the CEO and his managers within the scope of the requirements and responsibility areas of the job and workplace

Requirements

  • Previous experience in a customer support or similar customer-facing role is preferred.
  • Must be fluent verbal and written communication skills in Norwegian and English,
  • Ability to actively listen, empathize, and communicate effectively with customers of varying backgrounds and levels of technical expertise.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to analyze situations, identify issues, and provide appropriate solutions.
  • Proficiency in using customer support software, CRM systems, and other relevant tools.
  • Adaptability and flexibility to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, ensuring accurate documentation and follow-up.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Availability to work on a flexible schedule, including weekends and holidays if required.
  • A positive attitude, patience, and a genuine desire to assist customers.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary synonymous with skills and experience
  • Performance and bonus structure dependent on achievement of set targets and personal performance
  • B2B Consultancy agreement for remote agreement with 25 days PTO

The Shift schedule for this position is as follows:
Working Days: Monday to Sunday
Shifts: 07:00 - 23:00 GMT+1 (split between Morning and Afternoon shifts)
